[color=#00ffff][size=4][b]重要/Important[/b][/size][/color]
[size=3]1.The main body of this module includes a hat, a top (dress), a head of hair, and five accessories (bat, cane, makeup (just face without head), shoes, pumpkin lantern). The remaining display content is included in the HD item package.
1.本模组主体包含一个帽子，一件上衣（连衣裙），一顶头发，和五个配饰（蝙蝠，手杖，妆容（只是脸不含头），鞋，南瓜灯）。其余展示内容均在HD物品包内。
[/size][/size][size=3]
2.The HD item pack is a separate mod that contains some important HD accessories. Due to the limited content, it is currently available for download on this mod page.
2，HD物品包是一个单独的模组，里面含有一些重要的HD配件，因为内容太少所以目前暂时放在此mod页面提供下载。

3.All projects only drew frames for standing, walking, running, and sitting, so the texture may be misaligned when the character performs other actions (completing all action frames is a big task, and due to my limited time and energy, it will be difficult to achieve).
3.所有项目均只绘制了站立，行走，跑步和坐下的动作帧，所以角色做出其他动作时纹理会发生错位（要补全所有动作是项很大的工作，介于我的时间和精力有限所以不做补充）。

4.Please do not ride horses when using this mod, as there will be texture errors when the character has HD items on them. This problem is beyond my personal ability and cannot be solved by simply changing the parameters. Please forgive me.
4.使用本模组请一定不要骑马，因为当角色身上存在HD物品时，骑马一定会发生纹理错误，这个问题超出了我的个人能力范围，单凭我更改参数是无法解决的，请见谅。

5.Please do not transfer/resell/integrate my mods, nor do you pay for unauthorized mod files under any pretext for the sake of convenience.
